segments.dn4:1.1: Evaṃ me sutaṃ – ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā aṅgesu cārikaṃ caramāno mahatā bhikkhusaṅghena saddhiṃ pañcamattehi bhikkhusatehi yena campā tadavasari.
segments.dn4:1.3: Tatra sudaṃ bhagavā campāyaṃ viharati gaggarāya pokkharaṇiyā tīre.
segments.dn4:1.4: Tena kho pana samayena soṇadaṇḍo brāhmaṇo campaṃ ajjhāvasati sattussadaṃ satiṇakaṭṭhodakaṃ sadhaññaṃ rājabhoggaṃ raññā māgadhena seniyena bimbisārena dinnaṃ rājadāyaṃ brahmadeyyaṃ.
segments.dn4:2.2: “samaṇo khalu bho gotamo sakyaputto sakyakulā pabbajito aṅgesu cārikaṃ caramāno mahatā bhikkhusaṅghena saddhiṃ pañcamattehi bhikkhusatehi campaṃ anuppatto campāyaṃ viharati gaggarāya pokkharaṇiyā tīre.
segments.dn4:2.3: Taṃ kho pana bhavantaṃ gotamaṃ evaṃ kalyāṇo kittisaddo abbhuggato –
segments.dn4:2.4: ‘itipi so bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho vijjācaraṇasampanno sugato lokavidū anuttaro purisadammasārathi satthā devamanussānaṃ buddho bhagavā’ti.
segments.dn4:2.5: So imaṃ lokaṃ sadevakaṃ samārakaṃ sabrahmakaṃ sassamaṇabrāhmaṇiṃ pajaṃ sadevamanussaṃ sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā pavedeti.
segments.dn4:2.6: So dhammaṃ deseti ādikalyāṇaṃ majjhekalyāṇaṃ pariyosānakalyāṇaṃ sātthaṃ sabyañjanaṃ kevalaparipuṇṇaṃ parisuddhaṃ brahmacariyaṃ pakāseti.
segments.dn4:2.7: Sādhu kho pana tathārūpānaṃ arahataṃ dassanaṃ hotī”ti.
segments.dn4:2.8: Atha kho campeyyakā brāhmaṇagahapatikā campāya nikkhamitvā saṅghasaṅghī [saṅghā saṅghī (sī. syā. pī.)] gaṇībhūtā yena gaggarā pokkharaṇī tenupasaṅkamanti.
segments.dn4:3.1: Tena kho pana samayena soṇadaṇḍo brāhmaṇo uparipāsāde divāseyyaṃ upagato hoti.
segments.dn4:3.2: Addasā kho soṇadaṇḍo brāhmaṇo campeyyake brāhmaṇagahapatike campāya nikkhamitvā saṅghasaṅghī [saṅghe saṅghī (sī. pī.) saṅghā saṅghī (syā.)] gaṇībhūte yena gaggarā pokkharaṇī tenupasaṅkamante.
segments.dn4:3.4: “kiṃ nu kho, bho khatte, campeyyakā brāhmaṇagahapatikā campāya nikkhamitvā saṅghasaṅghī gaṇībhūtā yena gaggarā pokkharaṇī tenupasaṅkamantī”ti?
segments.dn4:3.5: “Atthi kho, bho, samaṇo gotamo sakyaputto sakyakulā pabbajito aṅgesu cārikaṃ caramāno mahatā bhikkhusaṅghena saddhiṃ pañcamattehi bhikkhusatehi campaṃ anuppatto campāyaṃ viharati gaggarāya pokkharaṇiyā tīre.
segments.dn4:3.6: Taṃ kho pana bhavantaṃ gotamaṃ evaṃ kalyāṇo kittisaddo abbhuggato –
segments.dn4:3.7: ‘itipi so bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho vijjācaraṇasampanno sugato lokavidū anuttaro purisadammasārathi satthā devamanussānaṃ buddho bhagavā’ti.
segments.dn4:3.9: “Tena hi, bho khatte, yena campeyyakā brāhmaṇagahapatikā tenupasaṅkama, upasaṅkamitvā campeyyake brāhmaṇagahapatike evaṃ vadehi –
segments.dn4:3.10: ‘soṇadaṇḍo, bho, brāhmaṇo evamāha – āgamentu kira bhavanto, soṇadaṇḍopi brāhmaṇo samaṇaṃ gotamaṃ dassanāya upasaṅkamissatī’”ti.
segments.dn4:3.12: “Evaṃ, bho”ti kho so khattā soṇadaṇḍassa brāhmaṇassa paṭissutvā yena campeyyakā brāhmaṇagahapatikā tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā campeyyake brāhmaṇagahapatike etadavoca –
segments.dn4:3.14: ‘āgamentu kira bhavanto, soṇadaṇḍopi brāhmaṇo samaṇaṃ gotamaṃ dassanāya upasaṅkamissatī’”ti.
segments.dn4:4.1: Tena kho pana samayena nānāverajjakānaṃ brāhmaṇānaṃ pañcamattāni brāhmaṇasatāni campāyaṃ paṭivasanti kenacideva karaṇīyena.
segments.dn4:4.3: “soṇadaṇḍo kira brāhmaṇo samaṇaṃ gotamaṃ dassanāya upasaṅkamissatī”ti.
segments.dn4:4.4: Atha kho te brāhmaṇā yena soṇadaṇḍo brāhmaṇo tenupasaṅkamiṃsu; upasaṅkamitvā soṇadaṇḍaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ etadavocuṃ –
segments.dn4:4.5: “saccaṃ kira bhavaṃ soṇadaṇḍo samaṇaṃ gotamaṃ dassanāya upasaṅkamissatī”ti?
segments.dn4:5.1: “Mā bhavaṃ soṇadaṇḍo samaṇaṃ gotamaṃ dassanāya upasaṅkami.
segments.dn4:5.2: Na arahati bhavaṃ soṇadaṇḍo samaṇaṃ gotamaṃ dassanāya upasaṅkamituṃ.
segments.dn4:5.3: Sace bhavaṃ soṇadaṇḍo samaṇaṃ gotamaṃ dassanāya upasaṅkamissati, bhoto soṇadaṇḍassa yaso hāyissati, samaṇassa gotamassa yaso abhivaḍḍhissati.
segments.dn4:5.4: Yampi bhoto soṇadaṇḍassa yaso hāyissati, samaṇassa gotamassa yaso abhivaḍḍhissati, imināpaṅgena na arahati bhavaṃ soṇadaṇḍo samaṇaṃ gotamaṃ dassanāya upasaṅkamituṃ;
segments.dn4:5.5: samaṇotveva gotamo arahati bhavantaṃ soṇadaṇḍaṃ dassanāya upasaṅkamituṃ.
segments.dn4:5.6: “Bhavañhi soṇadaṇḍo ubhato sujāto mātito ca pitito ca, saṃsuddhagahaṇiko yāva sattamā pitāmahayugā akkhitto anupakkuṭṭho jātivādena.
segments.dn4:5.7: Yampi bhavaṃ soṇadaṇḍo ubhato sujāto mātito ca pitito ca, saṃsuddhagahaṇiko yāva sattamā pitāmahayugā akkhitto anupakkuṭṭho jātivādena, imināpaṅgena na arahati bhavaṃ soṇadaṇḍo samaṇaṃ gotamaṃ dassanāya upasaṅkamituṃ;
segments.dn4:5.8: samaṇotveva gotamo arahati bhavantaṃ soṇadaṇḍaṃ dassanāya upasaṅkamituṃ.
segments.dn4:5.10: “Bhavañhi soṇadaṇḍo ajjhāyako, mantadharo, tiṇṇaṃ vedānaṃ pāragū sanighaṇḍukeṭubhānaṃ sākkharappabhedānaṃ itihāsapañcamānaṃ padako veyyākaraṇo, lokāyatamahāpurisalakkhaṇesu anavayo … pe …
segments.dn4:5.11: “Bhavañhi soṇadaṇḍo abhirūpo dassanīyo pāsādiko paramāya vaṇṇapokkharatāya samannāgato brahmavaṇṇī brahmavacchasī [brahmaḍḍhī (sī.), brahmavaccasī (pī.)] akhuddāvakāso dassanāya … pe …
segments.dn4:5.12: “Bhavañhi soṇadaṇḍo sīlavā vuddhasīlī vuddhasīlena samannāgato … pe …
segments.dn4:5.13: “Bhavañhi soṇadaṇḍo kalyāṇavāco kalyāṇavākkaraṇo poriyā vācāya samannāgato vissaṭṭhāya anelagalāya [aneḷagalāya (sī. pī.), anelagaḷāya (ka)] atthassa viññāpaniyā … pe …
segments.dn4:5.14: “Bhavañhi soṇadaṇḍo bahūnaṃ ācariyapācariyo tīṇi māṇavakasatāni mante vāceti. Bahū kho pana nānādisā nānājanapadā māṇavakā āgacchanti bhoto soṇadaṇḍassa santike mantatthikā mante adhiyitukāmā … pe …
segments.dn4:5.15: “Bhavañhi soṇadaṇḍo jiṇṇo vuddho mahallako addhagato vayoanuppatto;
segments.dn4:5.16: samaṇo gotamo taruṇo ceva taruṇapabbajito ca … pe …
segments.dn4:5.17: “Bhavañhi soṇadaṇḍo rañño māgadhassa seniyassa bimbisārassa sakkato garukato mānito pūjito apacito … pe …
segments.dn4:5.18: “Bhavañhi soṇadaṇḍo brāhmaṇassa pokkharasātissa sakkato garukato mānito pūjito apacito … pe …
segments.dn4:5.19: “Bhavañhi soṇadaṇḍo campaṃ ajjhāvasati sattussadaṃ satiṇakaṭṭhodakaṃ sadhaññaṃ rājabhoggaṃ, raññā māgadhena seniyena bimbisārena dinnaṃ, rājadāyaṃ brahmadeyyaṃ.
segments.dn4:5.20: Yampi bhavaṃ soṇadaṇḍo campaṃ ajjhāvasati sattussadaṃ satiṇakaṭṭhodakaṃ sadhaññaṃ rājabhoggaṃ, raññā māgadhena seniyena bimbisārena dinnaṃ, rājadāyaṃ brahmadeyyaṃ.
segments.dn4:5.21: Imināpaṅgena na arahati bhavaṃ soṇadaṇḍo samaṇaṃ gotamaṃ dassanāya upasaṅkamituṃ;
segments.dn4:5.22: samaṇotveva gotamo arahati bhavantaṃ soṇadaṇḍaṃ dassanāya upasaṅkamitun”ti.
segments.dn4:6.1: Evaṃ vutte, soṇadaṇḍo brāhmaṇo te brāhmaṇe etadavoca –
segments.dn4:6.2: “Tena hi, bho, mamapi suṇātha, yathā mayameva arahāma taṃ bhavantaṃ gotamaṃ dassanāya upasaṅkamituṃ;
segments.dn4:6.3: natveva arahati so bhavaṃ gotamo amhākaṃ dassanāya upasaṅkamituṃ.
segments.dn4:6.4: Samaṇo khalu, bho, gotamo ubhato sujāto mātito ca pitito ca, saṃsuddhagahaṇiko yāva sattamā pitāmahayugā, akkhitto anupakkuṭṭho jātivādena.
segments.dn4:6.5: Yampi bho samaṇo gotamo ubhato sujāto mātito ca pitito ca saṃsuddhagahaṇiko yāva sattamā pitāmahayugā, akkhitto anupakkuṭṭho jātivādena, imināpaṅgena na arahati so bhavaṃ gotamo amhākaṃ dassanāya upasaṅkamituṃ;
segments.dn4:6.6: atha kho mayameva arahāma taṃ bhavantaṃ gotamaṃ dassanāya upasaṅkamituṃ.
segments.dn4:6.7: “Samaṇo khalu, bho, gotamo mahantaṃ ñātisaṅghaṃ ohāya pabbajito … pe …
segments.dn4:6.8: “Samaṇo khalu, bho, gotamo pahūtaṃ hiraññasuvaṇṇaṃ ohāya pabbajito bhūmigatañca vehāsaṭṭhaṃ ca … pe …
segments.dn4:6.9: “Samaṇo khalu, bho, gotamo daharova samāno yuvā susukāḷakeso bhadrena yobbanena samannāgato paṭhamena vayasā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajito … pe …
segments.dn4:6.10: “Samaṇo khalu, bho, gotamo akāmakānaṃ mātāpitūnaṃ assumukhānaṃ rudantānaṃ kesamassuṃ ohāretvā kāsāyāni vatthāni acchādetvā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajito … pe …
segments.dn4:6.11: “Samaṇo khalu, bho, gotamo abhirūpo dassanīyo pāsādiko paramāya vaṇṇapokkharatāya samannāgato, brahmavaṇṇī, brahmavacchasī, akhuddāvakāso dassanāya … pe …
segments.dn4:6.12: “Samaṇo khalu, bho, gotamo sīlavā ariyasīlī kusalasīlī kusalasīlena samannāgato … pe …
segments.dn4:6.13: “Samaṇo khalu, bho, gotamo kalyāṇavāco kalyāṇavākkaraṇo poriyā vācāya samannāgato vissaṭṭhāya anelagalāya atthassa viññāpaniyā … pe …
segments.dn4:6.14: “Samaṇo khalu, bho, gotamo bahūnaṃ ācariyapācariyo … pe …
segments.dn4:6.15: “Samaṇo khalu, bho, gotamo khīṇakāmarāgo vigatacāpallo … pe …
segments.dn4:6.16: “Samaṇo khalu, bho, gotamo kammavādī kiriyavādī apāpapurekkhāro brahmaññāya pajāya … pe …
segments.dn4:6.17: “Samaṇo khalu, bho, gotamo uccā kulā pabbajito asambhinnakhattiyakulā … pe …
segments.dn4:6.18: “Samaṇo khalu, bho, gotamo aḍḍhā kulā pabbajito mahaddhanā mahābhogā … pe …
segments.dn4:6.19: “Samaṇaṃ khalu, bho, gotamaṃ tiroraṭṭhā tirojanapadā pañhaṃ pucchituṃ āgacchanti … pe …
segments.dn4:6.20: “Samaṇaṃ khalu, bho, gotamaṃ anekāni devatāsahassāni pāṇehi saraṇaṃ gatāni … pe …
segments.dn4:6.21: “Samaṇaṃ khalu, bho, gotamaṃ evaṃ kalyāṇo kittisaddo abbhuggato –
segments.dn4:6.22: ‘itipi so bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho vijjācaraṇasampanno sugato lokavidū anuttaro purisadammasārathi satthā devamanussānaṃ buddho bhagavā’ti … pe …
segments.dn4:6.23: “Samaṇo khalu, bho, gotamo dvattiṃsamahāpurisalakkhaṇehi samannāgato … pe …
segments.dn4:6.24: “Samaṇo khalu, bho, gotamo ehisvāgatavādī sakhilo sammodako abbhākuṭiko uttānamukho pubbabhāsī … pe …
segments.dn4:6.25: “Samaṇo khalu, bho, gotamo catunnaṃ parisānaṃ sakkato garukato mānito pūjito apacito … pe …
segments.dn4:6.26: “Samaṇe khalu, bho, gotame bahū devā ca manussā ca abhippasannā … pe …
segments.dn4:6.27: “Samaṇo khalu, bho, gotamo yasmiṃ gāme vā nigame vā paṭivasati, na tasmiṃ gāme vā nigame vā amanussā manusse viheṭhenti … pe …
segments.dn4:6.28: “Samaṇo khalu, bho, gotamo saṅghī gaṇī gaṇācariyo puthutitthakarānaṃ aggamakkhāyati. Yathā kho pana, bho, etesaṃ samaṇabrāhmaṇānaṃ yathā vā tathā vā yaso samudāgacchati, na hevaṃ samaṇassa gotamassa yaso samudāgato.
segments.dn4:6.29: Atha kho anuttarāya vijjācaraṇasampadāya samaṇassa gotamassa yaso samudāgato … pe …
segments.dn4:6.30: “Samaṇaṃ khalu, bho, gotamaṃ rājā māgadho seniyo bimbisāro saputto sabhariyo sapariso sāmacco pāṇehi saraṇaṃ gato … pe …
segments.dn4:6.31: “Samaṇaṃ khalu, bho, gotamaṃ rājā pasenadi kosalo saputto sabhariyo sapariso sāmacco pāṇehi saraṇaṃ gato … pe …
segments.dn4:6.32: “Samaṇaṃ khalu, bho, gotamaṃ brāhmaṇo pokkharasāti saputto sabhariyo sapariso sāmacco pāṇehi saraṇaṃ gato … pe …
segments.dn4:6.33: “Samaṇo khalu, bho, gotamo rañño māgadhassa seniyassa bimbisārassa sakkato garukato mānito pūjito apacito … pe …
segments.dn4:6.34: “Samaṇo khalu, bho, gotamo rañño pasenadissa kosalassa sakkato garukato mānito pūjito apacito … pe …
segments.dn4:6.35: “Samaṇo khalu, bho, gotamo brāhmaṇassa pokkharasātissa sakkato garukato mānito pūjito apacito … pe …
segments.dn4:6.36: “Samaṇo khalu, bho, gotamo campaṃ anuppatto, campāyaṃ viharati gaggarāya pokkharaṇiyā tīre.
segments.dn4:6.37: Ye kho pana, bho, keci samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā amhākaṃ gāmakhettaṃ āgacchanti atithī no te honti.
segments.dn4:6.38: Atithī kho panamhehi sakkātabbā garukātabbā mānetabbā pūjetabbā apacetabbā.
segments.dn4:6.39: Yampi, bho, samaṇo gotamo campaṃ anuppatto campāyaṃ viharati gaggarāya pokkharaṇiyā tīre, atithimhākaṃ samaṇo gotamo;
segments.dn4:6.40: atithi kho panamhehi sakkātabbo garukātabbo mānetabbo pūjetabbo apacetabbo.
segments.dn4:6.41: Imināpaṅgena na arahati so bhavaṃ gotamo amhākaṃ dassanāya upasaṅkamituṃ.
segments.dn4:6.42: Atha kho mayameva arahāma taṃ bhavantaṃ gotamaṃ dassanāya upasaṅkamituṃ.
segments.dn4:6.43: Ettake kho ahaṃ, bho, tassa bhoto gotamassa vaṇṇe pariyāpuṇāmi, no ca kho so bhavaṃ gotamo ettakavaṇṇo.
segments.dn4:6.45: Evaṃ vutte, te brāhmaṇā soṇadaṇḍaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ etadavocuṃ –
segments.dn4:6.46: “yathā kho bhavaṃ soṇadaṇḍo samaṇassa gotamassa vaṇṇe bhāsati ito cepi so bhavaṃ gotamo yojanasate viharati, alameva saddhena kulaputtena dassanāya upasaṅkamituṃ api puṭosenā”ti.
segments.dn4:6.47: “Tena hi, bho, sabbeva mayaṃ samaṇaṃ gotamaṃ dassanāya upasaṅkamissāmā”ti.
segments.dn4:7.0: Soṇadaṇḍaparivitakko Atha kho soṇadaṇḍo brāhmaṇo mahatā brāhmaṇagaṇena saddhiṃ yena gaggarā pokkharaṇī tenupasaṅkami.
segments.dn4:8.1: Atha kho soṇadaṇḍassa brāhmaṇassa tirovanasaṇḍagatassa evaṃ cetaso parivitakko udapādi –
segments.dn4:8.2: “ahañceva kho pana samaṇaṃ gotamaṃ pañhaṃ puccheyyaṃ;
segments.dn4:8.3: tatra ce maṃ samaṇo gotamo evaṃ vadeyya –
segments.dn4:8.4: ‘na kho esa, brāhmaṇa, pañho evaṃ pucchitabbo, evaṃ nāmesa, brāhmaṇa, pañho pucchitabbo’ti, tena maṃ ayaṃ parisā paribhaveyya –
segments.dn4:8.5: ‘bālo soṇadaṇḍo brāhmaṇo abyatto, nāsakkhi samaṇaṃ gotamaṃ yoniso pañhaṃ pucchitun’ti.
segments.dn4:8.6: Yaṃ kho panāyaṃ parisā paribhaveyya, yasopi tassa hāyetha.
segments.dn4:8.7: Yassa kho pana yaso hāyetha, bhogāpi tassa hāyeyyuṃ.
segments.dn4:8.9: Mamañceva kho pana samaṇo gotamo pañhaṃ puccheyya, tassa cāhaṃ pañhassa veyyākaraṇena cittaṃ na ārādheyyaṃ;
segments.dn4:8.10: tatra ce maṃ samaṇo gotamo evaṃ vadeyya –
segments.dn4:8.11: ‘na kho esa, brāhmaṇa, pañho evaṃ byākātabbo, evaṃ nāmesa, brāhmaṇa, pañho byākātabbo’ti, tena maṃ ayaṃ parisā paribhaveyya –
segments.dn4:8.12: ‘bālo soṇadaṇḍo brāhmaṇo abyatto, nāsakkhi samaṇassa gotamassa pañhassa veyyākaraṇena cittaṃ ārādhetun’ti.
segments.dn4:8.13: Yaṃ kho panāyaṃ parisā paribhaveyya, yasopi tassa hāyetha.
segments.dn4:8.14: Yassa kho pana yaso hāyetha, bhogāpi tassa hāyeyyuṃ.
segments.dn4:8.16: Ahañceva kho pana evaṃ samīpagato samāno adisvāva samaṇaṃ gotamaṃ nivatteyyaṃ, tena maṃ ayaṃ parisā paribhaveyya –
segments.dn4:8.17: ‘bālo soṇadaṇḍo brāhmaṇo abyatto mānathaddho bhīto ca, no visahati samaṇaṃ gotamaṃ dassanāya upasaṅkamituṃ, kathañhi nāma evaṃ samīpagato samāno adisvā samaṇaṃ gotamaṃ nivattissatī’ti.
segments.dn4:8.18: Yaṃ kho panāyaṃ parisā paribhaveyya, yasopi tassa hāyetha.
segments.dn4:8.19: Yassa kho pana yaso hāyetha, bhogāpi tassa hāyeyyuṃ, yasoladdhā kho panamhākaṃ bhogā”ti.
segments.dn4:9.1: Atha kho soṇadaṇḍo brāhmaṇo yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā bhagavatā saddhiṃ sammodi.
segments.dn4:9.2: Sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sāraṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi.
segments.dn4:9.3: Campeyyakāpi kho brāhmaṇagahapatikā appekacce bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu; appekacce bhagavatā saddhiṃ sammodiṃsu; sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sāraṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu; appekacce yena bhagavā tenañjaliṃ paṇāmetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu; appekacce nāmagottaṃ sāvetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu; appekacce tuṇhībhūtā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu.
segments.dn4:10.1: Tatrapi sudaṃ soṇadaṇḍo brāhmaṇo etadeva bahulamanuvitakkento nisinno hoti –
segments.dn4:10.2: “ahañceva kho pana samaṇaṃ gotamaṃ pañhaṃ puccheyyaṃ;
segments.dn4:10.3: tatra ce maṃ samaṇo gotamo evaṃ vadeyya –
segments.dn4:10.4: ‘na kho esa, brāhmaṇa, pañho evaṃ pucchitabbo, evaṃ nāmesa, brāhmaṇa, pañho pucchitabbo’ti, tena maṃ ayaṃ parisā paribhaveyya –
segments.dn4:10.5: ‘bālo soṇadaṇḍo brāhmaṇo abyatto, nāsakkhi samaṇaṃ gotamaṃ yoniso pañhaṃ pucchitun’ti.
segments.dn4:10.6: Yaṃ kho panāyaṃ parisā paribhaveyya, yasopi tassa hāyetha.
segments.dn4:10.7: Yassa kho pana yaso hāyetha, bhogāpi tassa hāyeyyuṃ.
segments.dn4:10.9: Mamañceva kho pana samaṇo gotamo pañhaṃ puccheyya, tassa cāhaṃ pañhassa veyyākaraṇena cittaṃ na ārādheyyaṃ;
segments.dn4:10.10: tatra ce maṃ samaṇo gotamo evaṃ vadeyya –
segments.dn4:10.11: ‘na kho esa, brāhmaṇa, pañho evaṃ byākātabbo, evaṃ nāmesa, brāhmaṇa, pañho byākātabbo’ti, tena maṃ ayaṃ parisā paribhaveyya –
segments.dn4:10.12: ‘bālo soṇadaṇḍo brāhmaṇo abyatto, nāsakkhi samaṇassa gotamassa pañhassa veyyākaraṇena cittaṃ ārādhetun’ti.
segments.dn4:10.13: Yaṃ kho panāyaṃ parisā paribhaveyya, yasopi tassa hāyetha.
segments.dn4:10.14: Yassa kho pana yaso hāyetha, bhogāpi tassa hāyeyyuṃ.
segments.dn4:10.16: Aho vata maṃ samaṇo gotamo sake ācariyake tevijjake pañhaṃ puccheyya, addhā vatassāhaṃ cittaṃ ārādheyyaṃ pañhassa veyyākaraṇenā”ti.
segments.dn4:11.1: Atha kho bhagavato soṇadaṇḍassa brāhmaṇassa cetasā cetoparivitakkamaññāya etadahosi –
segments.dn4:11.2: “vihaññati kho ayaṃ soṇadaṇḍo brāhmaṇo sakena cittena.
segments.dn4:11.3: Yaṃnūnāhaṃ soṇadaṇḍaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ sake ācariyake tevijjake pañhaṃ puccheyyan”ti.
segments.dn4:11.4: Atha kho bhagavā soṇadaṇḍaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ etadavoca –
segments.dn4:11.5: “katihi pana, brāhmaṇa, aṅgehi samannāgataṃ brāhmaṇā brāhmaṇaṃ paññapenti;
segments.dn4:11.6: ‘brāhmaṇosmī’ti ca vadamāno sammā vadeyya, na ca pana musāvādaṃ āpajjeyyā”ti?
segments.dn4:12.2: “yaṃ vata no ahosi icchitaṃ, yaṃ ākaṅkhitaṃ, yaṃ adhippetaṃ, yaṃ abhipatthitaṃ –
segments.dn4:12.3: ‘aho vata maṃ samaṇo gotamo sake ācariyake tevijjake pañhaṃ puccheyya, addhā vatassāhaṃ cittaṃ ārādheyyaṃ pañhassa veyyākaraṇenā’ti, tatra maṃ samaṇo gotamo sake ācariyake tevijjake pañhaṃ pucchati.
segments.dn4:12.4: Addhā vatassāhaṃ cittaṃ ārādhessāmi pañhassa veyyākaraṇenā”ti.
segments.dn4:13.1: Atha kho soṇadaṇḍo brāhmaṇo abbhunnāmetvā kāyaṃ anuviloketvā parisaṃ bhagavantaṃ etadavoca –
segments.dn4:13.2: “pañcahi, bho gotama, aṅgehi samannāgataṃ brāhmaṇā brāhmaṇaṃ paññapenti;
segments.dn4:13.3: ‘brāhmaṇosmī’ti ca vadamāno sammā vadeyya, na ca pana musāvādaṃ āpajjeyya.
segments.dn4:13.5: Idha, bho gotama, brāhmaṇo ubhato sujāto hoti mātito ca pitito ca, saṃsuddhagahaṇiko yāva sattamā pitāmahayugā akkhitto anupakkuṭṭho jātivādena;
segments.dn4:13.6: ajjhāyako hoti mantadharo tiṇṇaṃ vedānaṃ pāragū sanighaṇḍukeṭubhānaṃ sākkharappabhedānaṃ itihāsapañcamānaṃ padako veyyākaraṇo lokāyatamahāpurisalakkhaṇesu anavayo;
segments.dn4:13.7: abhirūpo hoti dassanīyo pāsādiko paramāya vaṇṇapokkharatāya samannāgato brahmavaṇṇī brahmavacchasī akhuddāvakāso dassanāya;
segments.dn4:13.9: paṇḍito ca hoti medhāvī paṭhamo vā dutiyo vā sujaṃ paggaṇhantānaṃ.
segments.dn4:13.10: Imehi kho, bho gotama, pañcahi aṅgehi samannāgataṃ brāhmaṇā brāhmaṇaṃ paññapenti;
segments.dn4:13.11: ‘brāhmaṇosmī’ti ca vadamāno sammā vadeyya, na ca pana musāvādaṃ āpajjeyyā”ti.
segments.dn4:14.1: “Imesaṃ pana, brāhmaṇa, pañcannaṃ aṅgānaṃ sakkā ekaṃ aṅgaṃ ṭhapayitvā catūhaṅgehi samannāgataṃ brāhmaṇā brāhmaṇaṃ paññapetuṃ;
segments.dn4:14.2: ‘brāhmaṇosmī’ti ca vadamāno sammā vadeyya, na ca pana musāvādaṃ āpajjeyyā”ti?
segments.dn4:14.4: Imesañhi, bho gotama, pañcannaṃ aṅgānaṃ vaṇṇaṃ ṭhapayāma.
segments.dn4:14.6: Yato kho, bho gotama, brāhmaṇo ubhato sujāto hoti mātito ca pitito ca saṃsuddhagahaṇiko yāva sattamā pitāmahayugā akkhitto anupakkuṭṭho jātivādena;
segments.dn4:14.7: ajjhāyako ca hoti mantadharo ca tiṇṇaṃ vedānaṃ pāragū sanighaṇḍukeṭubhānaṃ sākkharappabhedānaṃ itihāsapañcamānaṃ padako veyyākaraṇo lokāyatamahāpurisalakkhaṇesu anavayo;
segments.dn4:14.8: sīlavā ca hoti vuddhasīlī vuddhasīlena samannāgato;
segments.dn4:14.9: paṇḍito ca hoti medhāvī paṭhamo vā dutiyo vā sujaṃ paggaṇhantānaṃ.
segments.dn4:14.10: Imehi kho bho gotama catūhaṅgehi samannāgataṃ brāhmaṇā brāhmaṇaṃ paññapenti;
segments.dn4:14.11: ‘brāhmaṇosmī’ti ca vadamāno sammā vadeyya, na ca pana musāvādaṃ āpajjeyyā”ti.
segments.dn4:15.1: “Imesaṃ pana, brāhmaṇa, catunnaṃ aṅgānaṃ sakkā ekaṃ aṅgaṃ ṭhapayitvā tīhaṅgehi samannāgataṃ brāhmaṇā brāhmaṇaṃ paññapetuṃ;
segments.dn4:15.2: ‘brāhmaṇosmī’ti ca vadamāno sammā vadeyya, na ca pana musāvādaṃ āpajjeyyā”ti?
segments.dn4:15.4: Imesañhi, bho gotama, catunnaṃ aṅgānaṃ mante ṭhapayāma.
segments.dn4:15.6: Yato kho, bho gotama, brāhmaṇo ubhato sujāto hoti mātito ca pitito ca saṃsuddhagahaṇiko yāva sattamā pitāmahayugā akkhitto anupakkuṭṭho jātivādena;
segments.dn4:15.7: sīlavā ca hoti vuddhasīlī vuddhasīlena samannāgato;
segments.dn4:15.8: paṇḍito ca hoti medhāvī paṭhamo vā dutiyo vā sujaṃ paggaṇhantānaṃ.
segments.dn4:15.9: Imehi kho, bho gotama, tīhaṅgehi samannāgataṃ brāhmaṇā brāhmaṇaṃ paññapenti;
segments.dn4:15.10: ‘brāhmaṇosmī’ti ca vadamāno sammā vadeyya, na ca pana musāvādaṃ āpajjeyyā”ti.
segments.dn4:16.1: “Imesaṃ pana, brāhmaṇa, tiṇṇaṃ aṅgānaṃ sakkā ekaṃ aṅgaṃ ṭhapayitvā dvīhaṅgehi samannāgataṃ brāhmaṇā brāhmaṇaṃ paññapetuṃ;
segments.dn4:16.2: ‘brāhmaṇosmī’ti ca vadamāno sammā vadeyya, na ca pana musāvādaṃ āpajjeyyā”ti?
segments.dn4:16.4: Imesañhi, bho gotama, tiṇṇaṃ aṅgānaṃ jātiṃ ṭhapayāma.
segments.dn4:16.6: Yato kho, bho gotama, brāhmaṇo sīlavā hoti vuddhasīlī vuddhasīlena samannāgato;
segments.dn4:16.7: paṇḍito ca hoti medhāvī paṭhamo vā dutiyo vā sujaṃ paggaṇhantānaṃ.
segments.dn4:16.8: Imehi kho, bho gotama, dvīhaṅgehi samannāgataṃ brāhmaṇā brāhmaṇaṃ paññapenti;
segments.dn4:16.9: ‘brāhmaṇosmī’ti ca vadamāno sammā vadeyya, na ca pana musāvādaṃ āpajjeyyā”ti.
segments.dn4:17.1: Evaṃ vutte, te brāhmaṇā soṇadaṇḍaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ etadavocuṃ –
segments.dn4:17.2: “mā bhavaṃ soṇadaṇḍo evaṃ avaca, mā bhavaṃ soṇadaṇḍo evaṃ avaca.
segments.dn4:17.3: Apavadateva bhavaṃ soṇadaṇḍo vaṇṇaṃ, apavadati mante, apavadati jātiṃ ekaṃsena. Bhavaṃ soṇadaṇḍo samaṇasseva gotamassa vādaṃ anupakkhandatī”ti.
segments.dn4:18.1: Atha kho bhagavā te brāhmaṇe etadavoca –
segments.dn4:18.3: ‘appassuto ca soṇadaṇḍo brāhmaṇo, akalyāṇavākkaraṇo ca soṇadaṇḍo brāhmaṇo, duppañño ca soṇadaṇḍo brāhmaṇo, na ca pahoti soṇadaṇḍo brāhmaṇo samaṇena gotamena saddhiṃ asmiṃ vacane paṭimantetun’ti, tiṭṭhatu soṇadaṇḍo brāhmaṇo, tumhe mayā saddhiṃ mantavho asmiṃ vacane.
segments.dn4:18.4: Sace pana tumhākaṃ brāhmaṇānaṃ evaṃ hoti –
segments.dn4:18.5: ‘bahussuto ca soṇadaṇḍo brāhmaṇo, kalyāṇavākkaraṇo ca soṇadaṇḍo brāhmaṇo, paṇḍito ca soṇadaṇḍo brāhmaṇo, pahoti ca soṇadaṇḍo brāhmaṇo samaṇena gotamena saddhiṃ asmiṃ vacane paṭimantetun’ti, tiṭṭhatha tumhe, soṇadaṇḍo brāhmaṇo mayā saddhiṃ paṭimantetū”ti.
segments.dn4:19.1: Evaṃ vutte, soṇadaṇḍo brāhmaṇo bhagavantaṃ etadavoca –
segments.dn4:19.2: “tiṭṭhatu bhavaṃ gotamo, tuṇhī bhavaṃ gotamo hotu, ahameva tesaṃ sahadhammena paṭivacanaṃ karissāmī”ti.
segments.dn4:19.3: Atha kho soṇadaṇḍo brāhmaṇo te brāhmaṇe etadavoca –
segments.dn4:19.4: “mā bhavanto evaṃ avacuttha, mā bhavanto evaṃ avacuttha –
segments.dn4:19.5: ‘apavadateva bhavaṃ soṇadaṇḍo vaṇṇaṃ, apavadati mante, apavadati jātiṃ ekaṃsena. Bhavaṃ soṇadaṇḍo samaṇasseva gotamassa vādaṃ anupakkhandatī’ti.
segments.dn4:19.6: Nāhaṃ, bho, apavadāmi vaṇṇaṃ vā mante vā jātiṃ vā”ti.
segments.dn4:20.1: Tena kho pana samayena soṇadaṇḍassa brāhmaṇassa bhāgineyyo aṅgako nāma māṇavako tassaṃ parisāyaṃ nisinno hoti.
segments.dn4:20.2: Atha kho soṇadaṇḍo brāhmaṇo te brāhmaṇe etadavoca –
segments.dn4:20.3: “passanti no bhonto imaṃ aṅgakaṃ māṇavakaṃ amhākaṃ bhāgineyyan”ti?
segments.dn4:20.5: “Aṅgako kho, bho, māṇavako abhirūpo dassanīyo pāsādiko paramāya vaṇṇapokkharatāya samannāgato brahmavaṇṇī brahmavacchasī akhuddāvakāso dassanāya, nāssa imissaṃ parisāyaṃ samasamo atthi vaṇṇena ṭhapetvā samaṇaṃ gotamaṃ.
segments.dn4:20.6: Aṅgako kho māṇavako ajjhāyako mantadharo, tiṇṇaṃ vedānaṃ pāragū sanighaṇḍukeṭubhānaṃ sākkharappabhedānaṃ itihāsapañcamānaṃ padako veyyākaraṇo lokāyatamahāpurisalakkhaṇesu anavayo.
segments.dn4:20.8: Aṅgako kho māṇavako ubhato sujāto mātito ca pitito ca saṃsuddhagahaṇiko yāva sattamā pitāmahayugā akkhitto anupakkuṭṭho jātivādena.
segments.dn4:20.10: Aṅgako kho māṇavako pāṇampi haneyya, adinnampi ādiyeyya, paradārampi gaccheyya, musāvādampi bhaṇeyya, majjampi piveyya, ettha dāni, bho, kiṃ vaṇṇo karissati, kiṃ mantā, kiṃ jāti?
segments.dn4:20.11: Yato kho, bho, brāhmaṇo sīlavā ca hoti vuddhasīlī vuddhasīlena samannāgato, paṇḍito ca hoti medhāvī paṭhamo vā dutiyo vā sujaṃ paggaṇhantānaṃ.
segments.dn4:20.13: Imehi kho, bho, dvīhaṅgehi samannāgataṃ brāhmaṇā brāhmaṇaṃ paññapenti;
segments.dn4:20.14: ‘brāhmaṇosmī’ti ca vadamāno sammā vadeyya, na ca pana musāvādaṃ āpajjeyyā”ti.
segments.dn4:21.1: “Imesaṃ pana, brāhmaṇa, dvinnaṃ aṅgānaṃ sakkā ekaṃ aṅgaṃ ṭhapayitvā ekena aṅgena samannāgataṃ brāhmaṇā brāhmaṇaṃ paññapetuṃ;
segments.dn4:21.2: ‘brāhmaṇosmī’ti ca vadamāno sammā vadeyya, na ca pana musāvādaṃ āpajjeyyā”ti?
segments.dn4:21.4: Sīlaparidhotā hi, bho gotama, paññā; paññāparidhotaṃ sīlaṃ.
segments.dn4:21.5: Yattha sīlaṃ tattha paññā, yattha paññā tattha sīlaṃ.
segments.dn4:21.8: Seyyathāpi, bho gotama, hatthena vā hatthaṃ dhoveyya, pādena vā pādaṃ dhoveyya;
segments.dn4:21.9: evameva kho, bho gotama, sīlaparidhotā paññā, paññāparidhotaṃ sīlaṃ.
segments.dn4:21.10: Yattha sīlaṃ tattha paññā, yattha paññā tattha sīlaṃ.
segments.dn4:22.1: “Evametaṃ, brāhmaṇa, evametaṃ, brāhmaṇa, sīlaparidhotā hi, brāhmaṇa, paññā, paññāparidhotaṃ sīlaṃ.
segments.dn4:22.2: Yattha sīlaṃ tattha paññā, yattha paññā tattha sīlaṃ.
segments.dn4:22.5: Seyyathāpi, brāhmaṇa, hatthena vā hatthaṃ dhoveyya, pādena vā pādaṃ dhoveyya;
segments.dn4:22.6: evameva kho, brāhmaṇa, sīlaparidhotā paññā, paññāparidhotaṃ sīlaṃ.
segments.dn4:22.7: Yattha sīlaṃ tattha paññā, yattha paññā tattha sīlaṃ.
segments.dn4:22.13: Sādhu vata bhavantaṃyeva gotamaṃ paṭibhātu etassa bhāsitassa attho”ti.
segments.dn4:23.1: “Tena hi, brāhmaṇa, suṇohi; sādhukaṃ manasikarohi; bhāsissāmī”ti.
segments.dn4:23.2: “Evaṃ, bho”ti kho soṇadaṇḍo brāhmaṇo bhagavato paccassosi.
segments.dn4:23.4: “idha, brāhmaṇa, tathāgato loke uppajjati arahaṃ sammāsambuddho … pe …(yathā 190-212 anucchedesu tathā vitthāretabbaṃ).
segments.dn4:23.5: Evaṃ kho, brāhmaṇa, bhikkhu sīlasampanno hoti.
segments.dn4:23.6: Idaṃ kho taṃ, brāhmaṇa, sīlaṃ … pe … paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati … pe … dutiyaṃ jhānaṃ … pe … tatiyaṃ jhānaṃ … pe … catutthaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati … pe … ñāṇadassanāya cittaṃ abhinīharati, abhininnāmeti.
segments.dn4:23.12: Idampissa hoti paññāya … pe … nāparaṃ itthattāyāti pajānāti, idampissa hoti paññāya ayaṃ kho sā, brāhmaṇa, paññā”ti.
segments.dn4:24.1: Evaṃ vutte, soṇadaṇḍo brāhmaṇo bhagavantaṃ etadavoca –
segments.dn4:24.3: Seyyathāpi, bho gotama, nikkujjitaṃ vā ukkujjeyya, paṭicchannaṃ vā vivareyya, mūḷhassa vā maggaṃ ācikkheyya, andhakāre vā telapajjotaṃ dhāreyya,‘cakkhumanto rūpāni dakkhantī’ti; evamevaṃ bhotā gotamena anekapariyāyena dhammo pakāsito.
segments.dn4:24.4: Esāhaṃ bhavantaṃ gotamaṃ saraṇaṃ gacchāmi, dhammañca, bhikkhusaṅghañca.
segments.dn4:24.5: Upāsakaṃ maṃ bhavaṃ gotamo dhāretu ajjatagge pāṇupetaṃ saraṇaṃ gataṃ.
segments.dn4:24.6: Adhivāsetu ca me bhavaṃ gotamo svātanāya bhattaṃ saddhiṃ bhikkhusaṅghenā”ti.
segments.dn4:24.8: Atha kho soṇadaṇḍo brāhmaṇo bhagavato adhivāsanaṃ viditvā uṭṭhāyāsanā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā pakkāmi.
segments.dn4:24.9: Atha kho soṇadaṇḍo brāhmaṇo tassā rattiyā accayena sake nivesane paṇītaṃ khādanīyaṃ bhojanīyaṃ paṭiyādāpetvā bhagavato kālaṃ ārocāpesi –
segments.dn4:25.1: Atha kho bhagavā pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaramādāya saddhiṃ bhikkhusaṅghena yena soṇadaṇḍassa brāhmaṇassa nivesanaṃ tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā paññatte āsane nisīdi.
segments.dn4:25.2: Atha kho soṇadaṇḍo brāhmaṇo buddhappamukhaṃ bhikkhusaṅghaṃ paṇītena khādanīyena bhojanīyena sahatthā santappesi sampavāresi.
segments.dn4:26.1: Atha kho soṇadaṇḍo brāhmaṇo bhagavantaṃ bhuttāviṃ onītapattapāṇiṃ aññataraṃ nīcaṃ āsanaṃ gahetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi.
segments.dn4:26.2: Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho soṇadaṇḍo brāhmaṇo bhagavantaṃ etadavoca –
segments.dn4:26.3: “ahañceva kho pana, bho gotama, parisagato samāno āsanā vuṭṭhahitvā bhavantaṃ gotamaṃ abhivādeyyaṃ, tena maṃ sā parisā paribhaveyya.
segments.dn4:26.4: Yaṃ kho pana sā parisā paribhaveyya, yasopi tassa hāyetha.
segments.dn4:26.5: Yassa kho pana yaso hāyetha, bhogāpi tassa hāyeyyuṃ.
segments.dn4:26.7: Ahañceva kho pana, bho gotama, parisagato samāno añjaliṃ paggaṇheyyaṃ, āsanā me taṃ bhavaṃ gotamo paccuṭṭhānaṃ dhāretu.
segments.dn4:26.8: Ahañceva kho pana, bho gotama, parisagato samāno veṭhanaṃ omuñceyyaṃ, sirasā me taṃ bhavaṃ gotamo abhivādanaṃ dhāretu.
segments.dn4:26.9: Ahañceva kho pana, bho gotama, yānagato samāno yānā paccorohitvā bhavantaṃ gotamaṃ abhivādeyyaṃ, tena maṃ sā parisā paribhaveyya.
segments.dn4:26.10: Yaṃ kho pana sā parisā paribhaveyya, yasopi tassa hāyetha, yassa kho pana yaso hāyetha, bhogāpi tassa hāyeyyuṃ.
segments.dn4:26.12: Ahañceva kho pana, bho gotama, yānagato samāno patodalaṭṭhiṃ abbhunnāmeyyaṃ, yānā me taṃ bhavaṃ gotamo paccorohanaṃ dhāretu.
segments.dn4:26.13: Ahañceva kho pana, bho gotama, yānagato samāno chattaṃ apanāmeyyaṃ, sirasā me taṃ bhavaṃ gotamo abhivādanaṃ dhāretū”ti.
segments.dn4:27.1: Atha kho bhagavā soṇadaṇḍaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ dhammiyā kathāya sandassetvā samādapetvā samuttejetvā sampahaṃsetvā uṭṭhāyāsanā pakkāmīti.

lines: Aṅgesūti aṅgā nāma aṅgapāsādikatāya evaṃ laddhavohārā jānapadino rājakumārā, tesaṃ nivāso ekopi janapado rūḷhisaddena aṅgāti vuccati, tasmiṃ aṅgesu janapade.
Cārikanti idhāpi aturitacārikā ceva nibaddhacārikā ca adhippetā.
Tadā kira bhagavato dasasahassilokadhātuṃ olokentassa soṇadaṇḍo brāhmaṇo ñāṇajālassa anto paññāyittha.
Atha bhagavā ayaṃ brāhmaṇo mayhaṃ ñāṇajāle paññāyati.
‘Mayi tattha gate etassa antevāsino dvādasahākārehi brāhmaṇassa vaṇṇaṃ bhāsitvā mama santike āgantuṃ na dassanti.
So pana tesaṃ vādaṃ bhinditvā ekūnatiṃsa ākārehi mama vaṇṇaṃ bhāsitvā maṃ upasaṅkamitvā pañhaṃ pucchissati.
So pañhavissajjanapariyosāne saraṇaṃ gamissatī’ti, disvā pañcasatabhikkhuparivāro taṃ janapadaṃ paṭipanno.
Tena vuttaṃ – aṅgesu cārikaṃ caramāno … pe … yena campā tadavasarīti.
Gaggarāya pokkharaṇiyā tīreti tassa campānagarassa avidūre gaggarāya nāma rājaggamahesiyā khaṇitattā gaggarāti laddhavohārā pokkharaṇī atthi.
Tassā tīre samantato nīlādipañcavaṇṇakusumapaṭimaṇḍitaṃ mahantaṃ campakavanaṃ.
Taṃ sandhāya gaggarāya pokkharaṇiyā tīreti vuttaṃ.
Māgadhena seniyena bimbisārenāti ettha so rājā magadhānaṃ issarattā māgadho.
Pubbe nagarassa anto agaṇā bahi nikkhamitvā gaṇataṃ pattāti gaṇībhūtā.
Khattā vuccati pucchitapañhe byākaraṇasamattho mahāmatto, taṃ āmantesi āgamentūti muhuttaṃ paṭimānentu, mā gacchantūti vuttaṃ hoti.
Nānāverajjakānanti nānāvidhesu rajjesu, aññesu aññesu kāsikosalādīsu rajjesu jātā, tāni vā tesaṃ nivāsā, tato vā āgatāti nānāverajjakā, tesaṃ nānāverajjakānaṃ.
Kenacideva karaṇīyenāti tasmiṃ kira nagare dvīhi karaṇīyehi brāhmaṇā sannipatanti – yaññānubhavanatthaṃ vā mantasajjhāyanatthaṃ vā.
Tadā ca tasmiṃ nagare yamaññā natthi.
Soṇadaṇḍassa pana santike mantasajjhāyanatthaṃ ete sannipatitā.
“ayaṃ soṇadaṇḍo uggatabrāhmaṇo yebhuyyena ca aññe brāhmaṇā samaṇaṃ gotamaṃ saraṇaṃ gatā, ayameva na gato.
Svāyaṃ sace tattha gamissati, addhā samaṇassa gotamassa āvaṭṭaniyā māyāya āvaṭṭito, taṃ saraṇaṃ gamissati.
Tato etassāpi gehadvāre brāhmaṇānaṃ sannipāto na bhavissatī”ti.
Taṃ sandhāya – atha kho te brāhmaṇātiādi vuttaṃ.
Handassa vaṇṇaṃ bhaṇanena gamanaṃ nivāressāmā”ti cintetvā bhavañhi soṇadaṇḍo ubhato sujātotiādīni kāraṇāni āhaṃsu.
Mātito ca pitito cāti bhoto mātā brāhmaṇī, mātumātā brāhmaṇī, tassāpi mātā brāhmaṇī;
pitā brāhmaṇo, pitupitā brāhmaṇo, tassāpi pitā brāhmaṇoti, evaṃ bhavaṃ ubhato sujāto mātito ca pitito ca.
Samavepākiniyā gahaṇiyāti ettha pana kammajatejodhātu “gahaṇī”ti vuccati.
Yāva sattamā pitāmahayugāti ettha pitupitā pitāmaho, pitāmahassa yugaṃ pitāmahayugaṃ.
Tato uddhaṃ sabbepi pubbapurisā pitāmahaggahaṇeneva gahitā.
Evaṃ yāva sattamo puriso, tāva saṃsuddhagahaṇiko.
Atha vā akkhitto anupakuṭṭho jātivādenāti dassenti.
“apanetha etaṃ, kiṃ iminā”ti evaṃ akkhitto anavakkhitto.
Anupakuṭṭhoti na upakuṭṭho, na akkosaṃ vā nindaṃ vā laddhapubbo.
Bhavato hi gehe pathaviyaṃ paṃsuvālikā viya bahudhanaṃ, samaṇo pana gotamo adhano bhikkhāya udaraṃ pūretvā yāpetīti dassenti.
Evaṃ yaṃ yaṃ guṇaṃ vadanti, tassa tassa paṭipakkhavasena bhagavato aguṇaṃyeva dassemāti maññamānā vadanti.
Pokkharatā vuccati sundarabhāvo, vaṇṇassa pokkharatā vaṇṇapokkharatā, tāya vaṇṇasampattiyā yuttoti attho.
Iti paramāya vaṇṇapokkharatāyāti uttamena parisuddhena vaṇṇena ceva sarīrasaṇṭhānasampattiyā cāti attho.
Akhuddāvakāso dassanāyāti “bhoto sarīre dassanassa okāso na khuddako mahā, sabbāneva te aṅgapaccaṅgāni dassanīyāneva, tāni cāpi mahantānevā”ti dīpenti.
Kalyāṇavācotiādīsu kalyāṇā sundarā parimaṇḍalapadabyañjanā vācā assāti kalyāṇavāco.
Poriyā nāgarikitthiyā sukhumālattanena sadisāti porī, tāya poriyā.
Yassa kassaci hi kathentassa elā gaḷanti, lālā vā paggharanti, kheḷaphusitāni vā nikkhamanti, tassa vācā elagaḷaṃ nāma hoti, tabbiparitāyāti attho.
Atthassa viññāpaniyāti ādimajjhapariyosānaṃ pākaṭaṃ katvā bhāsitatthassa viññāpanasamatthāya.
Addhagatoti addhānaṃ gato, dve tayo rājaparivaṭṭe atītoti adhippāyo.
Vayoanuppattoti pacchimavayaṃ sampatto, pacchimavayo nāma vassasatassa pacchimo tatiyabhāgo.
Api ca jiṇṇoti porāṇo, cirakālappavattakulanvayoti vuttaṃ hoti.
“ime brāhmaṇā jātiādīhi mama vaṇṇaṃ vadanti, na kho pana metaṃ yuttaṃ attano vaṇṇe rajjituṃ.
Handāhaṃ etesaṃ vādaṃ bhinditvā samaṇassa gotamassa mahantabhāvaṃ ñāpetvā etesaṃ tattha gamanaṃ karomī”ti cintetvā tena hi – bho mamapi suṇāthātiādimāha.
Tattha yepi ubhato sujātoti ādayo attano guṇehi sadisā guṇā tepi;
“ko cāhaṃ ke ca samaṇassa gotamassa jātisampattiādayo guṇā”ti attano guṇehi uttaritareyeva maññamāno, itare pana ekanteneva bhagavato mahantabhāvadīpanatthaṃ pakāseti.
Yathā hi sineruṃ upanidhāya sāsapo, mahāsamuddaṃ upanidhāya gopadakaṃ, sattasu mahāsaresu udakaṃ upanidhāya ussāvabindu paritto lāmako.
Evameva samaṇassa gotamassa jātisampattiādayopi guṇe upanidhāya amhākaṃ guṇā parittā lāmakā;
tasmā mayameva arahāma taṃ bhavantaṃ gotamaṃ dassanāya upasaṅkamitun”ti.
Mahantaṃ ñātisaṃghaṃ ohāyāti mātipakkhe asītikulasahassāni, pitipakkhe asītikulasahassānīti evaṃ saṭṭhikulasatasahassaṃ ohāya pabbajito.
Bhūmigatañca vehāsaṭṭhañcāti ettha rājaṅgaṇe ceva uyyāne ca sudhāmaṭṭhapokkharaṇiyo sattaratanānaṃ pūretvā bhūmiyaṃ ṭhapitaṃ dhanaṃ bhūmigataṃ nāma.
Tathāgatassa pana jātadivaseyeva saṅkho, elo, uppalo, puṇḍarīkoti cattāro nidhayo uggatā.
Tesu saṅkho gāvutiko, elo aḍḍhayojaniko, uppalo tigāvutiko, puṇḍarīko yojaniko.
Tesupi gahitaṃ gahitaṃ pūratiyeva, iti bhagavā pahūtaṃ hiraññasuvaṇṇaṃ ohāya pabbajitoti veditabbo.
Susukāḷakesoti suṭṭhu kāḷakeso, añjanavaṇṇasadisakeso hutvā vāti attho.
Assūni mukhe etesanti assumukhā, tesaṃ assumukhānaṃ, assūhi kilinnamukhānanti attho.
Akhuddāvakāsoti ettha bhagavato aparimāṇoyeva dassanāya okāsoti veditabbo.

Tatridaṃ vatthu – rājagahe kira aññataro brāhmaṇo samaṇassa gotamassa pamāṇaṃ gahetuṃ na sakkotīti sutvā bhagavato piṇḍāya pavisanakāle saṭṭhihatthaṃ veḷuṃ gahetvā nagaradvārassa bahi ṭhatvā sampatte bhagavati veḷuṃ gahetvā samīpe aṭṭhāsi.
Puna divase dve veḷū ghaṭetvā samīpe aṭṭhāsi.
Bhagavāpi dvinnaṃ veḷūnaṃ upari kaṭimattameva paññāyamāno –
“Brāhmaṇa, sacepi tvaṃ sakalacakkavāḷagabbhaṃ pūretvā ṭhite veḷū ghaṭetvā āgamissasi, neva me pamāṇaṃ gahetuṃ sakkhissasi.
Na hi mayā cattāri asaṅkhyeyāni kappasatasahassañca tathā pāramiyo pūritā, yathā me paro pamāṇaṃ gaṇheyya, atulo, brāhmaṇa, tathāgato appameyyo”ti vatvā dhammapade gāthamāha –
Na sakkā puññaṃ saṅkhātuṃ, imettamapi kenacī”ti.(dha. pa.36);
Aparampi vatthu – rāhu kira asurindo cattāri yojanasahassāni aṭṭha ca yojanasatāni ucco.
“So ahaṃ uccosmi, satthāraṃ onamitvā oloketuṃ na sakkhissāmī”ti cintetvā nāgacchi.
“catūsu iriyāpathesu katarena dassessāmī”ti cintetvā “ṭhitako nāma nīcopi ucco viya paññāyati.
Nipannovassa attānaṃ dassessāmī”ti “ānanda, gandhakuṭipariveṇe mañcakaṃ paññāpehī”ti vatvā tattha sīhaseyyaṃ kappesi.
Rāhu āgantvā nipannaṃ bhagavantaṃ gīvaṃ unnāmetvā nabhamajjhe puṇṇacandaṃ viya ullokesi.
Na mayā, asurinda, adhomukhena pāramiyo pūritā.
Catupārisuddhisīlena sīlavā, taṃ pana sīlaṃ ariyaṃ uttamaṃ parisuddhaṃ.
Bahūnaṃ ācariyapācariyoti bhagavato ekekāya dhammadesanāya caturāsītipāṇasahassāni aparimāṇāpi devamanussā maggaphalāmataṃ pivanti, tasmā bahūnaṃ ācariyo.
Khīṇakāmarāgoti ettha kāmaṃ bhagavato sabbepi kilesā khīṇā.
“pattamaṇḍanā cīvaramaṇḍanā senāsanamaṇḍanā imassa vā pūtikāyassa … pe … kelanā paṭikelanā”ti (vibha.854) evaṃ vuttacāpallā virahito.
Apāpapurekkhāroti apāpe nava lokuttaradhamme purato katvā vicarati.
Brahmaññāya pajāyāti sāriputtamoggallānamahākassapādibhedāya brāhmaṇapajāya, etissāya ca pajāya purekkhāro.
Ayañhi pajā samaṇaṃ gotamaṃ purakkhatvā caratīti attho.
Api ca apāpapurekkhāroti na pāpaṃ purekkhāro na pāpaṃ purato katvā carati, na pāpaṃ icchatīti attho.
Attanā saddhiṃ paṭiviruddhāyapi brāhmaṇapajāya aviruddho hitasukhatthiko yevāti vuttaṃ hoti.
Pañhaṃ pucchituṃ āgacchantīti khattiyapaṇḍitādayo ceva devabrahmanāgagandhabbādayo ca –
Tattha keci pucchāya vā dosaṃ vissajjanasampaṭicchane vā asamatthataṃ sallakkhetvā apucchitvāva tuṇhī nisīdanti.
Kesañci bhagavā pucchāya ussāhaṃ janetvā vissajjeti.
Evaṃ sabbesampi tesaṃ vimatiyo tīraṃ patvā mahāsamuddassa ūmiyo viya bhagavantaṃ patvā bhijjanti.
Ehi svāgatavādīti devamanussapabbajitagahaṭṭhesu taṃ taṃ attano santikaṃ āgataṃ –
“Yā sā vācā nelā kaṇṇasukhā”tiādinā nayena vuttasākhalyena samannāgato, muduvacanoti attho.
“kacci, bhikkhave, khamanīyaṃ, kacci yāpanīyan”tiādinā nayena sabbaṃ addhānadarathaṃ vūpasamento viya paṭhamataraṃ sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ kattāti attho.
Abbhākuṭikoti yathā ekacce parisaṃ patvā thaddhamukhā saṅkuṭitamukhā honti, na ediso, parisadassanena panassa bālātapasamphassena viya padumaṃ mukhapadumaṃ vikasati puṇṇacandasassirikaṃ hoti.
Uttānamukhoti yathā ekacce nikujjitamukhā viya sampattāya parisāya na kiñci kathenti, atidullabhakathā honti, na evarūpo.
“kasmā mayaṃ idhāgatā”ti vippaṭisāro uppajjati dhammaṃ pana sutvā attamanāva hontīti dasseti.
Pubbabhāsīti bhāsanto ca paṭhamataraṃ bhāsati, tañca kho kālayuttaṃ pamāṇayuttaṃ atthanissitameva bhāsati, na niratthakakathaṃ.

Na tasmiṃ gāme vāti yattha kira bhagavā paṭivasati, tattha mahesakkhā devatā ārakkhaṃ gaṇhanti, taṃ nissāya manussānaṃ upaddavo na hoti, paṃsupisācakādayoyeva hi manusse viheṭhenti, te tāsaṃ ānubhāvena dūraṃ apakkamanti.
Api ca bhagavato mettābalenapi na amanussā manusse viheṭhenti.
Saṅghītiādīsu anusāsitabbo sayaṃ vā uppādito saṅgho assa atthīti saṅghī.
Yathā vā tathā vāti yena vā tena vā acelakādimattakenāpi kāraṇena.
Atithi no te hontīti te amhākaṃ āgantukā, navakā pāhunakā hontīti attho.
Imaṃ pana satthu guṇakathaṃ sutvā te brāhmaṇā cintayiṃsu – yathā soṇadaṇḍo brāhmaṇo samaṇassa gotamassa vaṇṇe bhaṇati, anomaguṇo so bhavaṃ gotamo;
evaṃ tassa guṇe jānamānena kho pana ācariyena aticiraṃ adhivāsitaṃ, handa naṃ anuvattāmāti anuvattiṃsu.
Api puṭosenāti puṭosaṃ vuccati pātheyyaṃ, taṃ gahetvāpi upasaṅkamituṃ yuttamevāti attho.
Puṭaṃsenātipi pāṭho, tassattho, puṭo aṃse assāti puṭaṃso, tena puṭaṃsena.
Aṃsena hi pātheyyapuṭaṃ vahantenāpīti vuttaṃ hoti.
Añjaliṃ paṇāmetvāti ete ubhatopakkhikā, te evaṃ cintayiṃsu –
‘Kiṃ sīsena bhūmiyaṃ paharanteneva vandanaṃ nāma hoti, nanu añjalikammampi vandanaṃ evā’ti vakkhāmā”ti.
Nāmagottanti “bho, gotama, ahaṃ asukassa putto datto nāma, mitto nāma, idhāgato”ti vadantā nāmaṃ sāventi nāma.
“Bho, gotama, ahaṃ vāseṭṭho nāma, kaccāno nāma, idhāgato”ti vadantā gottaṃ sāventi nāma.
Ete kira daliddā jiṇṇā kulaputtā “parisamajjhe nāmagottavasena pākaṭā bhavissāmā”ti evamakaṃsu.
Ye pana tuṇhībhūtā nisīdiṃsu, te kerāṭikā ceva andhabālā ca.
“ekaṃ dve kathāsallāpepi karonto vissāsiko hoti, atha vissāse sati ekaṃ dve bhikkhā adātuṃ na yuttan”ti tato attānaṃ mocetvā tuṇhī nisīdanti.
Andhabālā aññāṇatāyeva avakkhittamattikāpiṇḍo viya yattha katthaci tuṇhībhūtā nisīdanti.
“ayaṃ brāhmaṇo āgatakālato paṭṭhāya adhomukho thaddhagatto kiṃ cintayamāno nisinno, kiṃ nu kho cintetī”ti āvajjanto attano cetasā tassa cittaṃ aññāsi.

Anuviloketvā parisanti bhagavato sakasamaye pañhapucchanena udake miyamāno ukkhipitvā thale ṭhapito viya samapassaddhakāyacitto hutvā parisaṃ saṅgaṇhanatthaṃ diṭṭhisañjāneneva “upadhārentu me bhonto vacanan”ti vadanto viya anuviloketvā parisaṃ bhagavantaṃ etadavoca.
311-313. Sujaṃ paggaṇhantānanti yaññayajanatthāya sujaṃ gaṇhantesu brāhmaṇesu paṭhamo vā dutiyo vāti attho.
Iti brāhmaṇo sakasamayavasena sammadeva pañhaṃ vissajjesi.
Etadavocunti sace jātivaṇṇamantasampanno brāhmaṇo na hoti, atha ko carahi loke brāhmaṇo bhavissati?
Nāseti no ayaṃ soṇadaṇḍo, handassa vādaṃ paṭikkhipissāmāti cintetvā etadavocuṃ.
“sace tvaṃ pasādavasena samaṇaṃ gotamaṃ saraṇaṃ gantukāmo, gaccha;
mā brāhmaṇassa samayaṃ bhindī”ti adhippāyena āhaṃsu.
Etadavocāti imesu brāhmaṇesu evaṃ ekappahāreneva viravantesu “ayaṃ kathā pariyosānaṃ na gamissati, handa ne nissadde katvā soṇadaṇḍeneva saddhiṃ kathemī”ti cintetvā –
Samasamoti ṭhapetvā ekadesasamattaṃ samabhāvena samo, sabbākārena samoti attho.
Ahamassa mātāpitaro jānāmīti bhaginiyā puttassa mātāpitaro kiṃ na jānissati, kulakoṭiparidīpanaṃ sandhāyeva vadati.
Kiṃ vaṇṇo karissatīti abbhantare guṇe asati kiṃ karissati?
“pakatisīle ṭhitassa brāhmaṇabhāvaṃ sādhentī”ti evampi sīlameva sādhessati, tasmiṃ hissa asati brāhmaṇabhāvo nāhosīti sammohamattaṃ vaṇṇādayo.
“sabhāvaṃ ācariyo āha, akāraṇāva mayaṃ ujjhāyimhā”ti tuṇhī ahesuṃ.
Tato bhagavā ‘kathito brāhmaṇena pañho, kiṃ panettha patiṭṭhātuṃ sakkhissati, na sakkhissatī’ti?
Yattha sīlaṃ tattha paññāti yasmiṃ puggale sīlaṃ, tattheva paññā, kuto dussīle paññā?
Paññārahite vā jaḷe eḷamūge kuto sīlanti?
Evametaṃ brāhmaṇāti bhagavā brāhmaṇassa vacanaṃ anujānanto āha.
Yassa puthujjanassa sīlaṃ saṭṭhiasītivassāni akhaṇḍaṃ hoti, so maraṇakālepi sabbakilese ghātetvā sīlena paññaṃ dhovitvā arahattaṃ gaṇhāti.
There kira maraṇamañce nipajjitvā balavavedanāya nitthunante, tissamahārājā “theraṃ passissāmī”ti gantvā pariveṇadvāre ṭhito taṃ saddaṃ sutvā pucchi –
“Pabbajjāya saṭṭhivassena vedanāpariggahamattampi na kataṃ, na dāni naṃ vandissāmī”ti nivattitvā mahābodhiṃ vandituṃ gato.
“kiṃ no, bhante, lajjāpetha, saddhopi rājā vippaṭisārī hutvā na vandissāmī”ti gatoti.
“Tena hi me okāsaṃ karothā”ti vatvā vedanaṃ vikkhambhitvā arahattaṃ patvā daharassa saññaṃ adāsi –
“nāhaṃ ayyassa arahattaṃ vandāmi, puthujjanabhūmiyaṃ pana ṭhatvā rakkhitasīlameva vandāmī”ti āha, evaṃ sīlena paññaṃ dhovati nāma.
Yassa pana abbhantare sīlasaṃvaro natthi, ugghāṭitaññutāya pana catuppadikagāthāpariyosāne paññāya sīlaṃ dhovitvā saha paṭisambhidāhi arahattaṃ pāpuṇāti.
Yaṃnūnāhaṃ brāhmaṇassa uttarivisesabhūtaṃ maggasīlaṃ, phalasīlaṃ, maggapaññaṃ, phalapaññañca dassetvā arahattanikūṭena desanaṃ niṭṭhapeyyan”ti.
“katamaṃ pana taṃ, brāhmaṇa, sīlaṃ katamā sā paññā”ti āha.
Samaṇo pana maṃ gotamo puna nivattitvā pucchati, idānissāhaṃ cittaṃ paritosetvā vissajjituṃ sakkuṇeyyaṃ vā na vā?
Sace na sakkhissaṃ paṭhamaṃ uppannāpi me lajjā bhijjissati.
Asakkontassa pana na sakkomīti vacane doso natthī”ti puna nivattitvā bhagavatoyeva bhāraṃ karonto “ettakaparamāva mayan”tiādimāha.
Tattha ettakaparamāti ettakaṃ sīlapaññāṇanti vacanameva paramaṃ amhākaṃ, te mayaṃ ettakaparamā, ito paraṃ etassa bhāsitassa atthaṃ na jānāmāti attho.
Athassa bhagavā sīlapaññāya mūlabhūtassa tathāgatassa uppādato pabhuti sīlapaññāṇaṃ dassetuṃ –
Tassattho sāmaññaphale vuttanayeneva veditabbo, ayaṃ pana viseso, idha tividhampi sīlaṃ –
“idampissa hoti sīlasmin”ti evaṃ sīlamicceva niyyātitaṃ paṭhamajjhānādīni cattāri jhānāni atthato paññāsampadā.
Evaṃ paññāvasena pana aniyyātetvā vipassanāpaññāya padaṭṭhānabhāvamattena dassetvā vipassanāpaññāto paṭṭhāya paññā niyyātitāti.
319-322. Svātanāyāti padassa attho ajjatanāyāti ettha vuttanayeneva veditabbo.
Tena maṃ sā parisā paribhaveyyāti tena tumhe dūratova disvā āsanā vuṭṭhitakāraṇena maṃ sā parisā –
“ayaṃ soṇadaṇḍo pacchimavaye ṭhito mahallako, gotamo pana daharo yuvā nattāpissa nappahoti, so nāma attano nattumattabhāvampi appattassa āsanā vuṭṭhātī”ti paribhaveyya.
Āsanā me taṃ bhavaṃ gotamo paccuṭṭhānanti mama agāravena avuṭṭhānaṃ nāma natthi, bhoganāsanabhayena pana na vuṭṭhahissāmi, taṃ tumhe hi ceva mayā ca ñātuṃ vaṭṭati.
Tasmā āsanā me etaṃ bhavaṃ gotamo paccuṭṭhānaṃ dhāretūti, iminā kira sadiso kuhako dullabho, bhagavati panassa agāravaṃ nāma natthi, tasmā bhoganāsanabhayā kuhanavasena evaṃ vadati.
Dhammiyā kathāyātiādīsu taṅkhaṇānurūpāya dhammiyā kathāya diṭṭhadhammikasamparāyikaṃ atthaṃ sandassetvā kusale dhamme samādapetvā gaṇhāpetvā.
Tattha naṃ samuttejetvā saussāhaṃ katvā tāya ca saussāhatāya aññehi ca vijjamānaguṇehi sampahaṃsetvā dhammaratanavassaṃ vassitvā uṭṭhāyāsanā pakkāmi.
Brāhmaṇo pana attano kuhakatāya evampi bhagavati dhammavassaṃ vassite visesaṃ nibbattetuṃ nāsakkhi.
Kevalamassa āyatiṃ nibbānatthāya vāsanābhāgiyāya ca sabbā purimapacchimakathā ahosīti.
Sundarabhāvena sātisayāni aṅgāni etesaṃ atthīti aṅgā, rājakumārāti āha “aṅgā nāma aṅgapāsādikatāyā”tiādi.
Āgantuṃ na dassantīti āgamane ādīnavaṃ dassetvā paṭikkhipanavasena āgantuṃ na dassanti, nānujānissantīti adhippāyo.
“Bhagavā kusumagandhasugandhe campakavane viharatī”ti iminā na māpanakāle eva tasmiṃ nagare campakarukkhā ussannā, atha kho aparabhāge pīti dasseti.
Māpanakāle hi campakānaṃ ussannatāya sā nagarī “campā”ti nāmaṃ labhi.
Senā etassa atthīti seniko, seniko eva seniyo, atthitā cettha bahubhāvavisiṭṭhāti vuttaṃ “mahatiyā senāya samannāgatattā”ti.
301-2. Saṃhatāti sannipatitā,“saṅghino”ti vattabbe “saṅghī”ti puthutthe ekavacanaṃ brāhmaṇagahapatikānaṃ adhippetattā, tenāha “etesan”ti.
Rājarājaññādīnaṃ bhaṇḍadharā purisā khatā, nesaṃ tāyanato khattā.
So hi yehi yattha pesito, tattha tesaṃ dosaṃ pariharanto yuttapattavasena pucchitamatthaṃ katheti, tenāha “pucchitapañhe byākaraṇasamattho”ti.
Visiṭṭhaṃ rajjaṃ virajjaṃ, virajjameva verajjaṃ yathā “vekataṃ vesayan”ti, nānāvidhaṃ verajjaṃ nānāverajjaṃ, tattha jātātiādinā sabbaṃ vuttanayeneva veditabbaṃ.
Uttamabrāhmaṇoti abhijanasampattiyā vittasampattiyā vijjāsampattiyā uggatataro, uḷāro vā brāhmaṇo.
“Ubhato sujāto”ti ettake vutte yehi kehici dvīhi bhāgehi sujātatā viññāyeyya.
Sujāta-saddo ca “sujāto cārudassano”tiādīsu (theragā.818) ārohasampattipariyāyoti jātivaseneva sujātataṃ vibhāvetuṃ “mātito ca pitito cā”ti vuttaṃ.
Anorasaputtavasenāpi loke mātupitusamaññā dissati, idha panassa orasaputtavaseneva icchitāti dassetuṃ “saṃsuddhagahaṇiko”ti vuttaṃ.
Yathābhuttassa āhārassa vipācanavasena gaṇhanato achaḍḍanato gahaṇī, kammajatejodhātu.
Pitā ca mātā ca pitaro, pitūnaṃ pitaro pitāmahā, tesaṃ yugo dvando pitāmahayugo, tasmā, yāva sattamā pitāmahayugā pitāmahadvandāti evamettha attho daṭṭhabbo.
Yuga-saddo cettha ekasesanayena daṭṭhabbo “yugo ca yugo ca yugā”ti.
Evañhi tattha tattha dvandaṃ gahitameva hoti, tenāha “tato uddhaṃ sabbepi pubbapurisā pitāmahaggahaṇeneva gahitā”ti.
Ettha ca “ubhato … pe … pitāmahayugā”ti etena brāhmaṇassa yonidosābhāvo dassito saṃsuddhagahaṇikabhāvakittanato,“akkhitto”ti iminā kiriyāparādhābhāvo.
Ayuttasaṃsaggampi hi paṭicca sattā akkosaṃ labhanti.
Issaroti ādhipateyyasaṃvattaniyakammabalena īsanasīlo, sā panassa issaratā vibhavasampattipaccayā pākaṭā jātāti aḍḍhatāpariyāyabhāveneva vadanto “aḍḍhoti issaro”ti āha.
Sarīranti sannivesavisiṭṭhaṃ karacaraṇagīvāsīsādiavayavasamudāyaṃ, so ca saṇṭhānamukhena gayhatīti “paramāya vaṇṇapokkharatāyāti … pe … sampattiyā cā”ti vuttaṃ.
Sabbavaṇṇesu suvaṇṇavaṇṇova uttamoti vuttaṃ “seṭṭhena suvaṇṇavaṇṇena samannāgato”ti.
Tathā hi buddhā, cakkavattino ca suvaṇṇavaṇṇāva honti.
Imameva hi atthaṃ sandhāya “mahābrahmuno sarīrasadiseneva sarīrena samannāgato”ti vuttaṃ, na brahmujugattataṃ.
Akhuddāvakāso dassanāyāti ārohapariṇāhasampattiyā, avayavapāripūriyā ca dassanāya okāso na khuddako, tenāha “sabbānevā”tiādi.
Taṃ panassa rattaññutāya vuddhaṃ vaḍḍhitaṃ atthīti vuddhasīlī.
Sabbametaṃ pañcasīlamattameva sandhāya vadanti tato paraṃ sīlassa tattha abhāvato, tesañca ajānanato.
Ṭhānakaraṇasampattiyā, sikkhāsampattiyā ca katthacipi anūnatāya parimaṇḍalapadāni byañjanāni akkharāni etissāti parimaṇḍalapadabyañjanā.
Atha vā pajjati attho etenāti padaṃ, nāmādi.
Pūreti ca purimasmiṃ atthe ādhāre bhummaṃ, dutiyasmiṃ visaye.
“Ādimajjhapariyosānaṃ pākaṭaṃ katvā”ti iminā tassā vācāya atthapāripūriṃ vadanti.
Dutiyanaye pana jiṇṇoti nāyaṃ jiṇṇatā vayomattena, atha kho kulaparivaṭṭena purāṇatāti āha “jiṇṇoti porāṇo”tiādi, tena tassa brāhmaṇassa kulavasena uditoditabhāvamāha.
Jātivuddhiyā “vayoanuppatto”ti vakkhamānattā, guṇavuddhiyā tato sātisayattā ca “vuddhoti sīlācārādiguṇavuddhiyā yutto”ti āha.
Tathā jātimahallakatāya vakkhamānattā “mahallako”ti padena vibhavamahattatā yojitā.
Maggapaṭipannoti brāhmaṇānaṃ paṭipattivīthiṃ upagato taṃ avokkamma caraṇato.
Tādisehi mahānubhāvehi saddhiṃ yugaggāhavasenapi dahanaṃ na mādisānaṃ anucchavikaṃ, kuto pana ukkaṃsananti idaṃ brāhmaṇassa na yuttarūpanti dassento āha “na kho pana metaṃ yuttan”tiādi.
Na hi buddhānaṃ guṇehi sabbathā sadisā kecipi guṇā aññesu labbhanti.
Gahitagahitanti gahitaṃ gahitaṃ ṭhānaṃ pūratiyeva dhanena paṭipākatikameva hoti.
Aparimāṇoyevāti “ettako eso”ti kenaci paricchindituṃ asakkuṇeyyatāya aparicchinno eva.
Sīhaseyyaṃ kappesīti yathā rāhu asurindo āyāmato, vitthārato ubbedhato ca bhagavato rūpakāyassa paricchedaṃ gahetuṃ na sakkoti, tathā rūpaṃ iddhābhisaṅkhāraṃ abhisaṅkharonto sīhaseyyaṃ kappesi.
Kilesehi ārakattā parisuddhaṭṭhena ariyanti āha “ariyaṃ uttamaṃ parisuddhan”ti.

Katthaci caturāsītipāṇasahassāni, katthaci aparimāṇāpi devamanussā yasmā catuvīsatiyā ṭhānesu asaṅkhyeyyā aparimeyyā devamanussā maggaphalāmataṃ piviṃsu, koṭisatasahassādiparimāṇenapi bahū eva, tasmā anuttarācārasikkhāpanavasena bhagavā bahūnaṃ ācariyo.
Apāpapurekkhāroti apāpe pure karoti, na vā pāpaṃ purato karotītipi apāpapurekkhāroti imamatthaṃ dassetuṃ “apāpe navalokuttaradhamme”tiādi vuttaṃ.

Brahmani seṭṭhe buddhe bhagavati bhavā tassa dhammadesanāvasena ariyāya jātiyā jātattā, brahmuno vā bhagavato hitā garukaraṇādinā, yathānusiṭṭhapaṭipattiyā ca, brahmaṃ vā seṭṭhaṃ ariyamaggaṃ jānātīti brahmaññā, ariyasāvakasaṅkhātā pajā, tenāha “sāriputtā”tiādi.
Pakatibrāhmaṇajātivasenāpi “brahmaññāya pajāyā”ti padassa attho veditabboti dassetuṃ “apicā”tiādi vuttaṃ.
Tiroraṭṭhā tirojanapadāti ettha rajjaṃ raṭṭhaṃ, rājanti rājāno etenāti, tadekadesabhūtā padesā pana janapado, janā pajjanti ettha sukhajīvikaṃ pāpuṇantīti.
Bhagavā vissajjeti tesaṃ upanissayasampattiṃ, ñāṇaparipākaṃ, cittācārañca ñatvāti adhippāyo.

“Ehi svāgatavādī”ti iminā sukhasambhāsapubbakaṃ piyavāditaṃ dasseti,“sakhilo”ti iminā saṇhavācataṃ,“sammodako”ti iminā paṭisandhārakusalataṃ,“abhākuṭiko”ti iminā sabbattheva vippasannamukhataṃ,“uttānamukho”ti iminā sukhālāpataṃ,“pubbabhāsī”ti iminā dhammānuggahassa okāsakaraṇato hitajjhāsayataṃ bhagavato vibhāveti.
Yattha kirāti kira -saddo arucisūcanattho, tena bhagavatā adhivutthapadese na devatānubhāvena manussānaṃ anupaddavatā, atha kho buddhānubhāvenāti dasseti.
Anusāsitabboti vineyyajanasamūho gayhatīti nibbattitaṃ ariyasaṅghameva dassetuṃ “sayaṃ vā”tiādi vuttaṃ, anantarassa vidhi paṭisedho vāti katvā.
Bahūnaṃ titthakarānanti pūraṇādīnaṃ anekesaṃ titthakarānaṃ, niddhāraṇe cetaṃ sāmivacanaṃ.
“Kappampi ce aññamabhāsamāno”ti abhūtaparikappanavacanametaṃ tathā bhāsamānassa abhāvato.
Alaṃ-saddo arahattopi hoti “alameva nibbinditun”tiādīsu (saṃ. ni.1.124) viyāti āha “alamevāti yuttamevā”ti.
Puṭena netvā asitabbato paribhuñjitabbato puṭosaṃ vuccati pātheyyaṃ.
Paṭhamo vāti tattha sannipatitesu yajanakiriyāyaṃ sabbapadhāno vā.
Aggihuttapamukhatāya yaññassa yaññe diyyamānaṃ sujāmukhena dīyatīti āha “sujāya diyyamānan”ti.
Hīnopamavasenapi samatā vuccatīti taṃ nivattento “ṭhapetvā ekadesasamattan”tiādimāha.
Kulakoṭiparidīpananti kulaādiparidīpanaṃ athāpi siyāti athāpi tumhākaṃ evaṃ parivitakko siyā.
Sammohamattaṃ vaṇṇādayoti vaṇṇamantajātiyo hi brāhmaṇabhāvassa aṅganti sammohamattametaṃ asamavekkhitābhimānabhāvato.
Kathito brāhmaṇena pañhoti “sīlavā ca hotī”tiādinā dvinnameva aṅgānaṃ vasena yathāpucchito pañho yāthāvato vissajjito etthāti etasmiṃ yathāvissajjite atthe.
Jaḷe eḷamūge kuto sīlanti jaḷe eḷamūge duppaññe kuto sīlaṃ sīlavibhāgassa, sīlaparisodhanūpāyassa ca ajānanato.
Pakaṭṭhaṃ ukkaṭṭhaṃ ñāṇaṃ paññāṇanti, pākatikaṃ ñāṇaṃ nivattetuṃ “paññāṇan”ti vuttanti tayidaṃ pakārehi jānanato paññāvāti āha “paññāṇanti paññā yevā”ti.
Sīlenadhotāti samādhipadaṭṭhānena sīlena sakalasaṃkilesamalavisuddhiyā dhotā visuddhā, tenāha “kathaṃ panā”tiādi.

Vedanāpariggahamattampīti ettha vedanāpariggaho nāma yathāuppannaṃ vedanaṃ sabhāvarasato upadhāretvā “ayaṃ vedanā phassaṃ paṭicca, so phasso anicco dukkho vipariṇāmadhammo”ti lakkhaṇattayaṃ āropetvā pavattitavipassanā.
Evaṃ vipassantena “sukhena sakkā sā vedanā adhivāsetuṃ “vedanā eva vediyatī”ti.
Vedanaṃ vikkhambhetvāti yathāuppannaṃ dukkhaṃ vedanaṃ ananuvattitvā vipassanaṃ ārabhitvā vīthiṃ paṭipannāya vipassanāya taṃ vinodetvā.
Paññāya sīlaṃ dhovitvāti akhaṇḍādibhāvāpādanena sīlaṃ ādimajjhapariyosānesu paññāya suvisodhitaṃ katvā.
Lajjā nāma “sīlassa jātiyā ca guṇadosapakāsanena samaṇena gotamena pucchitapañhaṃ vissajjesī”ti parisāya paññātatā.

Ettakaparamāti ettakaukkaṃsakoṭikā pañca sīlāni, vedattayavibhāvanaṃ paññañca lakkhaṇādito niddhāretvā jānanaṃ natthi, kevalaṃ tattha vacīparamā mayanti dassetīti āha “sīlapaññāṇanti vacanameva paramaṃ amhākan”ti.
“Ayaṃ pana viseso”ti idaṃ niyyātanāpekkhaṃ sīlaniddese, tenāha “sīlamicceva niyyātitan”ti.
Sāmaññaphale pana “sāmaññaphala” micceva niyyātitaṃ, paññāniddese pana jhānapaññaṃ adhiṭṭhānaṃ katvā vipassanāpaññāvaseneva paññāniyyātanaṃ kataṃ, tenāha “paṭhamajjhānādīnī”ti.
Agāravaṃ nāma natthi, na cāyaṃ bhagavati agāravena “ahañceva kho panā”tiādimāha, atha kho attalābhaparihānibhayena.
Ayañhi yathā tathā attano mahājanassa sambhāvanaṃ uppādetvā kohaññena pare vimhāpetvā lābhuppādaṃ nijigisanto vicarati, tasmā tathā avoca, tenāha “iminā kirā”tiādi.
Taṅkhaṇānurūpāyāti yādisī tadā tassa ajjhāsayappavatti, tadanurūpāyāti attho.

Tassa tadā tādisassa vivaṭṭasannissitassa ñāṇassa paripākassa abhāvato kevalaṃ abbhudayanissito eva attho dassitoti āha “diṭṭhadhammikasamparāyikamatthaṃ sandassetvā”ti, paccakkhato vibhāvetvāti attho.
Kusale dhammeti tebhūmake kusale dhamme,“catubhūmake” tipi vattuṃ vaṭṭatiyeva, tenevāha “āyatiṃ nibbānatthāya vāsanābhāgiyā vā”ti.
Nanti brāhmaṇaṃ samuttejetvāti sammadeva uparūpari nisānetvā puññakiriyāya tikkhavisadabhāvaṃ āpādetvā.
Taṃ pana atthato tattha ussāhajananaṃ hotīti āha “saussāhaṃ katvā”ti.

Evaṃ puññakiriyāya saussāhatā, evarūpaṃ guṇasamaṅgitā ca niyamato diṭṭhadhammikā atthasampādanīti evaṃ saussāhatāya, aññehi ca tasmiṃ vijjamānaguṇehi sampahaṃsetvā sammadeva haṭṭhatuṭṭhabhāvaṃ āpādetvā.
